mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, project_id, clock_in, clock_out, status, clock_in_lat, clock_in_lng, clock_out_lat, clock_out_lng, location_risk, created_at, updated_at FROM t_attendance WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND DATE(clock_in) = CURRENT_DATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_attendance (worker_id, project_id, clock_in, status, clock_in_lat, clock_in_lng, location_risk, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{projectId}, NOW(), #{status}, #{clockInLat}, #{clockInLng}, #{locationRisk}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_attendance SET clock_out = #{clockOut}, status = #{status}, clock_out_lat = #{clockOutLat}, clock_out_lng = #{clockOutLng}, location_risk = #{locationRisk}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
